subject: session date
fact: The events occur on the 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Stool
fact: Stool, the myconid, releases his rapport spores.
source_quote: Stool, the myconid, releases his rapport spores.

subject: telepathic communication begins
fact: Everyone starts talking in each other’s heads after Stool releases rapport spores.
source_quote: Then, everyone starts talking in each other’s heads.

subject: telepathic privacy established
fact: Everyone learns to focus on who they want to talk to, establishing mostly private telepathic conversations.
source_quote: Slowly, everyone learns to focus on who they want to talk to. For the most part, there is privacy, but there is no guarantee that someone won’t accidentally overhear a conversation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir peeks outside and observes that it is very dark.
source_quote: Zalthir peeks outside and observes that it’s very dark.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir plans to sneak into the tower, climb to the top floor, arm himself, and bring weapons back to the prisoners.
source_quote: He plans to sneak into the tower, then quickly climb up to the top floor, arm himself, and bring whatever weapons he can carry back to the prisoners, who can then use the arms to attack.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir trips while attempting to execute his plan.
source_quote: Zalthir trips.

subject: goblet shattered
fact: Daz kicks the goblet that Zalthir tripped on, causing it to shatter.
source_quote: Daz is startled and tries to help Zalthir, kicks the goblet that Zalthir tripped on. The goblet shatters.

subject: guards turn toward Zalthir and Daz
fact: The guards turn towards Zalthir and Daz after the goblet shatters.
source_quote: The guards turn towards Zalthir and Daz.

subject: Daz sends 'Plan B' telepathically
fact: Daz shouts in Thorin’s brain, 'Plan B.'
source_quote: Daz shouts in Thorin’s brain, “Plan B.”

subject: Thorin asks for Plan B
fact: Thorin shouts back, 'What is Plan B?'
source_quote: Thorin shouts back, “What is Plan B?”

subject: Zalthir asks for help
fact: Zalthir mumbles, 'Get in here and help us?'
source_quote: Zalthir mumbles, “Get in here and help us?”

subject: Thorin rushes into chamber
fact: Thorin rushes into the small chamber, climbing over a sprawled Zalthir and Daz.
source_quote: Thorin rushes into the small chamber, climbing over a sprawled Zalthir and Daz.

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber contains two Drow guards and one elite Drow male fighter.
source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.
source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters. It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.

subject: chamber
fact: The table in the chamber is set with the Drow game Sava.
source_quote: The table is set with the Drow game Sava.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is identified by Sarith as the elite Drow male fighter.
source_quote: whom Sarith identified as Imbros

subject: Thorin attempts to overpower Imbros
fact: Thorin tries to overpower the elite warrior Imbros but fails.
source_quote: He tries to overpower the elite warrior, whom Sarith identified as Imbros but fails.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is amused by the turn of events and considers killing Thorin but chooses not to.
source_quote: Imbros is, in turn, amused by the turn of events and is tempted to kill Thorin but chooses not.

subject: Imbros attempts to subdue Thorin
fact: Imbros tries to subdue Thorin and knock him unconscious.
source_quote: So he tries to subdue the dwarf and knock him unconscious.

subject: Zalthir attempts to shove Imbros
fact: Zalthir stands up and tries to shove Imbros.
source_quote: Zalthir stands up and tries to shove Imbros as well

subject: Zalthir's shove becomes a caress
fact: Zalthir, forgetting to position his hand, caresses Imbros instead of shoving him.
source_quote: instead of pushing Imbros, he caressed him.

subject: prisoners rush into armory
fact: The rest of the prisoners, led by Buppido, rush into the chamber and scramble into the armory.
source_quote: The rest of the prisoners, led by Buppido, take advantage of the distraction, rush into the chamber, and scramble into the armory.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil declares he is already armed and intends to kill the Drow.
source_quote: I am already armed in this hideous form, and it would bring me great joy to kill this drow.

subject: Prince Derendil charges Imbros
fact: Prince Derendil charges at Imbros.
source_quote: He then charges at Imbros.

subject: Grygum enters armory
fact: Gyrgum decides an armed cleric is better than a disarmed cleric and follows his fellow prisoners to the armory.
source_quote: Gyrgum decides that an armed cleric is better than a disarmed cleric and follows his fellow prisoners to the armory.

subject: Imbros strikes Thorin
fact: Imbros strikes Thorin, who falls, bleeding and unconscious.
source_quote: Imbros strikes Thorin, who falls, bleeding and unconscious.

subject: Daz casts Mind Sliver on Imbros
fact: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver, but the Drow is unaffected.
source_quote: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver, but the Drow is unaffected.

subject: Zalthir attacks Drow guard with fists
fact: Zalthir tries to strike one of the two Drow guards with his unarmed fists, and his fists land ineffectively.
source_quote: Zalthir tries to strike one of the two drow guards with his unarmed fists. His fists land ineffectively.

subject: Sarith attacks Drow guard
fact: Sarith attacks the same Drow guard that Zalthir flailed at and curses him in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.
source_quote: As the Sarith strikes his erstwhile comrade, he curses him in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.

subject: armory attackers descend
fact: From the opening in the roof, Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.
source_quote: Then, from the opening in the roof where the armory is, Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.

subject: Eldeth and Topsy hit Drow guard
fact: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.
source_quote: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.

subject: Ront kills Drow guard
fact: Ront squeezes into the fight and strikes at the guard, killing him.
source_quote: Ront, who prefers a straight-up fight, squeezes into the fight and strikes at the guard, killing him.

subject: Shuushar hits Imbros
fact: Shuushar aims at Imbros and hits.
source_quote: Shuushar aims at Imbros and hits.

subject: Buppido and Jimjar miss Imbros
fact: Buppido and Jimjar miss Imbros.
source_quote: Buppido and Jimjar miss.

subject: Jimjar forces telepathic attention
fact: Jimjar, having mastered Spool’s telepathy, forces everyone to listen to him when he says, 'You should have taken that bet.'
source_quote: “You should have taken that bet,” everyone hears Jimjar say. The Deep Gnome has mastered Spool’s telepathy and forces everyone to listen to him.

subject: Grygum heals Thorin
fact: Grygum stands over Thorin and heals him with a moment’s incantation and gentle touch, restoring his flesh, closing gashes, and knitting broken bones.
source_quote: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.

subject: Thorin regains vigor
fact: Thorin is flush with renewed vigor after being healed.
source_quote: Flush with renewed vigor, the formerly injured Thorin is ready to face the world once more.

subject: Daz casts Magic Missile
fact: Daz remembers how magic missiles work and casts three darts at Imbros.
source_quote: Daz has recovered from the disastrous opening gambit and remembers how magic missiles work. It’s not one dart, but three darts.

subject: Imbros reels from Magic Missile
fact: Imbros reels from the magical attack.
source_quote: Imbros reels from the magical attack.

subject: Thorin climbs to put on armor
fact: Thorin slips out of range of Imbros, climbs upstairs, and puts on some armor.
source_quote: Thorin slips out of range of the Drow, climbs upstairs, and puts on some armor.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros realizes he is fighting for his life and fears Ilvara might punish him like Sarith.
source_quote: Imbros now realizes he’s fighting for his life and realizes that if he doesn’t stop these slaves, Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.

subject: Imbros decides not to call for help
fact: Imbros remembers what happened to Drow who failed and chooses to deal with the revolt himself.
source_quote: He’s tempted to call for help and remembers what happened to Drow, who failed. “No, better to deal with this on my own.”

subject: Imbros poisons Prince Derendil
fact: Imbros strikes Prince Derendil twice using Drow Poison, injuring him and causing the poison to sting.
source_quote: Imbros strikes Prince Derendil twice; this time, he uses the Drow Poison. Prince Derendil is injured, and the poison stings.

subject: Zalthir misses Imbros again
fact: Zalthir again tries to strike Imbros and misses.
source_quote: Zalthir again tries to strike Imbros and misses.

subject: prisoners fire crossbows at Imbros
fact: The fellow escapees armed with hand crossbows fire at Imbros, who is struck three times.
source_quote: The fellow escapees armed with hand crossbows fire at Imbros, who is struck three times.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is still standing despite being struck multiple times.
source_quote: Imbros is still standing.

subject: Grygum casts Bell of Necrotic Power
fact: Grygum points his finger at Imbros, and the dolorous sound of a bell fills the room, attempting to consume him with necrotic power.
source_quote: Grygum points his finger at Imbros, and the dolorous sound of a bell fills the room.

subject: Imbros resists necrotic spell
fact: Imbros rejects the necrotic spell’s power.
source_quote: Imbros, for a moment, feels the necrotic power consume him but rejects the spell’s powers.

subject: Daz casts second Magic Missile
fact: Daz strikes with three more magic missiles at Imbros.
source_quote: Daz strikes with three more magic missiles.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros looks battered and barely alive but is still snarling.
source_quote: Imbros looks battered and barely alive, but he is still snarling.

subject: Imbros kills Prince Derendil
fact: Imbros stabs Prince Derendil to death.
source_quote: Prince Derendil’s journey ends with being stabbed to death by Imbros.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith suddenly goes mad and is about to scream at the top of his lungs after Prince Derendil’s death.
source_quote: Sarith suddenly goes mad. He is about to start screaming at the top of his lungs. For some reason, this death affected him deeply.

subject: Grygum calms Sarith telepathically
fact: Grygum reaches into Sarith’s mind and tells him to focus on his spirituality and divine purpose.
source_quote: Grygum notices and reaches into Sarith’s mind to tell Sarith to focus on his spirituality and how much better things will be if he chooses to focus his rage on the divine rather than on the material.

subject: Sarith is calmed
fact: Sarith is confused and calmed by Grygum’s intervention.
source_quote: Sarith is confused and calmed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum smiles, satisfied that the lessons of his cult have served him well.
source_quote: Grygum smiles. The lessons of his cult have served him well.

subject: Sarith kills Imbros
fact: Sarith smiles as his sword cuts Imbros down.
source_quote: And Sarith smiles, too, when his sword cuts Imbros down.

subject: fight ends
fact: The fight took less than a minute.
source_quote: The fight took less than a minute.

subject: prisoners secured weapons
fact: The prisoners have weapons after the fight.
source_quote: But they had weapons.

subject: prisoners improved position
fact: The prisoners are in a better place now than they were before.
source_quote: And they were in a better place now than they were before.

subject: Prince Derendil dies
fact: Prince Derendil is killed by Imbros during the revolt.
source_quote: Prince Derendil’s journey ends with being stabbed to death by Imbros.

subject: Drow guards
fact: Two Drow guards are present in the chamber and are killed during the revolt.
source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

subject: elite Drow fighter
fact: Imbros, an elite Drow male fighter, is present and killed during the revolt.
source_quote: whom Sarith identified as Imbros

subject: zurkhwood table
fact: The chamber contains a zurkhwood table.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs

subject: spider-silk webbing
fact: The chamber contains spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.
source_quote: and spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.

subject: Drow game Sava
fact: The table is set with the Drow game Sava.
source_quote: The table is set with the Drow game Sava.

subject: hand-held crossbows
fact: Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.
source_quote: Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.

subject: Drow Poison
fact: Imbros uses Drow Poison when striking Prince Derendil.
source_quote: he uses the Drow Poison

subject: Sarith's fate
fact: Imbros fears Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a cleric who uses divine healing magic.
source_quote: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is capable of casting Magic Missile and Mind Sliver.
source_quote: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver... Daz has recovered from the disastrous opening gambit and remembers how magic missiles work.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who was knocked unconscious and later healed.
source_quote: Imbros strikes Thorin, who falls, bleeding and unconscious... Flush with renewed vigor, the formerly injured Thorin is ready to face the world once more.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith was once a Drow companion but is now a rebel prisoner.
source_quote: As the Sarith strikes his erstwhile comrade, he curses him in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido leads the prisoners in rushing into the armory.
source_quote: The rest of the prisoners, led by Buppido, take advantage of the distraction, rush into the chamber, and scramble into the armory.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth attacks from the armory opening using a hand-held crossbow and hits a Drow guard.
source_quote: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy attacks from the armory opening using a hand-held crossbow and hits a Drow guard.
source_quote: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy attacks from the armory opening using a hand-held crossbow.
source_quote: Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar attacks from the armory opening using a hand-held crossbow and hits Imbros.
source_quote: Shuushar aims at Imbros and hits.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar attacks from the armory opening using a hand-held crossbow but misses Imbros.
source_quote: Buppido and Jimjar miss.

subject: Ront
fact: Ront joins the fight and kills the remaining Drow guard.
source_quote: Ront, who prefers a straight-up fight, squeezes into the fight and strikes at the guard, killing him.
